gauge.name: Clinton River at Mount Clemens

impacts.statement: Extensive overland and urban flooding occurs
Significant flood damage occurs mainly downstream from Groesbeck Road to the flood bypass canal
Low spots on romeo Plank Road by partridge creek golf course, Cass Avenue and Hydenrich Road sometimes due to high flows down the middle branch clinton river along with high levels on the main branch
The clubhouse at hillcrest country club floods
Lowland areas flood, including several golf courses
Lowland overflow begins adjacent to the river

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 48 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
